findings: SweepWindow.willOpen resolves ordinary SWEEP_CAMPAIGN first, then replaces the MID for Sakura/Chocolate/Fourth Anniversary/Polar Night before Backend.request.
MapDetailWindow/NewMapDetailWindow construct ordinary sweep params with campaign_id, campaign_type, sweep_num and sweep_type; awake_mission is also supplied for single sweep where applicable.
Backend.lua failed-request queue stores the same params table and reuses it on retry, making a once-injected campaign_sweep_op_id transport-stable.

SweepWindow success callback locally removes Raid Ticket 50001013 for ITEM_SWEEP and adds returned items to Backpack; application-error callbacks therefore need the Pass114 ordinary-MID117 guard to avoid local-only corruption.
campaign.lua remains source authority for deterministic sweep_reward and energy_cost; campaign_dropbox.lua remains raw increase_rate source data only.
No official server repeat-drop probability algorithm was recovered; campaign_repeat_rate_decomposition_v1 remains the accepted source-bounded private-server compatibility policy.
guards: UUID bridge executes only when resolved request MID equals xyd.mid.SWEEP_CAMPAIGN.
Event-specific sweep MIDs receive no campaign_sweep_op_id.
Ordinary MID117 body error_code suppresses SweepWindow local Ticket/reward mutation.
MID113 uses legacy CampaignDropPlanner.plan(first_clear=False) and remains disabled_unknown.
